userInput: The upload functionality for custom mixin files was removed when the top-level sections for mixins were introduced. The infrastructure still exists in the code. How complicated would it be to bring back the functionality?

alternatives.name: Add Upload as Dedicated "Uploads" Section in Grouped Dropdown
alternatives.description: Treat uploaded mixins as a special group section in the grouped dropdown UI. Modify parseGroupsFromYaml() to detect an 'Uploads' section or inject it synthetically. Add upload button at the bottom of the Uploads group header.
pros: Consistent with new grouped architecture - no special-case UI needed
Uses existing group rendering, collapse/expand, and checkbox-select-all logic
Upload button naturally sits next to 'Uploads' header
All existing upload infrastructure (storage, prompts, toasts) still works
Easy to discover - prominent in the main dropdown
Minimal code changes needed
cons: Requires modifying group header rendering to add action buttons
Need to inject synthetic 'Uploads' group if not in YAML source
Uploaded mixins are dynamic (user-added) but sections are normally static
Group checkboxes would select/deselect ALL uploads at once (may not be desired UX)

alternatives.name: Add Upload Button Inside Dropdown Footer
alternatives.description: Add a sticky footer area at the bottom of the dropdown (after all groups) with an 'Upload Mixin' button. No changes to group structure needed.
pros: Simplest implementation - just add a footer div to the dropdown
Doesn't interfere with group/section logic at all
Clear visual separation: groups on top, upload action at bottom
Minimal code changes
Works with any grouping structure
cons: Button disappears when dropdown is scrolled up
Adds visual complexity to the dropdown
Less integrated into the new sections paradigm
Might feel like an afterthought rather than part of the design

alternatives.name: Add Upload Button Next to Input Field (Like Search/Filter)
alternatives.description: Add a small upload icon button next to the mixin filter input field in the toolbar, similar to how search and zoom buttons sit in the main toolbar.
pros: Always visible, doesn't depend on dropdown state
Consistent with other toolbar actions
No changes needed to dropdown structure
Clear visual affordance
Easier to access than hiding in dropdown
cons: Takes up toolbar space
Less discoverable than being in the dropdown
Adds another button to already busy toolbar
Deviates from the 'upload via dropdown' paradigm

alternatives.name: Enhance 'Manage Uploaded Mixins' Button & Panel
alternatives.description: Keep current 'Manage Uploaded Mixins' button but make it more prominent. Add quick-add upload button directly in the 'Selected Mixins' left panel, alongside the filter input.
pros: Leverages existing UI components (modal popup already exists)
Dual-mode: quick inline upload + detailed management modal
Panel-based approach is consistent with existing left-side layout
No dropdown changes needed at all
cons: Still doesn't restore dropdown upload UX that users may expect
Requires learning new UI location for upload feature
Panel approach takes up screen real estate
More steps to upload (vs. one-click in dropdown)

alternatives.name: Full Reintegration: "Uploads" Meta-Group + Inline Button
alternatives.description: Create a dynamic 'Uploads' group that appears alongside other groups. Inject it into toolbarComboState.groups after parsing YAML. Add upload button in group header with full styling. Persist uploads in a special 'uploaded' YAML section if desired.
pros: Most polished UX - upload feels native to new architecture
Can persist uploads to a dedicated YAML section (survives page reload)
Uploaded items get full treatment: group collapse, select-all checkbox, proper styling
Clear mental model: 'Uploads' is just another section
Sets precedent if other dynamic sections needed in future
cons: More complex implementation - need to handle group injection
Need to update group collapse/expand state persistence
Group select-all checkbox behavior needs special handling for uploads
May need to modify YAML parsing to preserve upload section
Requires more careful state management

recommendation.approach: Alternative 1: Add Upload as Dedicated "Uploads" Section in Grouped Dropdown
recommendation.rationale:
This is the best balance of minimal effort and good UX:

**Why this approach:**
1. **Leverages Existing Code** - All upload infrastructure is already present and working. The grouped UI just needs to display it the same way it displays other sections.

2. **Minimal Implementation** - Requires only ~50-100 lines of code changes:
   - After parsing groups from YAML, inject a synthetic 'Uploads' group with currently-stored uploads
   - Add a small upload button (icon) to the group header template
   - Wire the button to `triggerToolbarComboUpload()` which already exists
   - No changes to the core group rendering logic needed

3. **Consistent UX** - Users see uploads as just another collapsible section, like 'Connections', 'Formats', etc. Familiar interaction patterns.

4. **Discoverable** - Upload button sits right in the dropdown where users expect to manage mixins.

5. **Works With Current Architecture** - The grouped dropdown already supports dynamic content per-group. Uploads just become another group.

**Implementation Steps:**
1. In `applyComboGroupsToUI()` or similar function where groups are set up, after processing YAML groups:
   - Get currently-stored uploads via `getUploadedMixins()`
   - Create synthetic group object: `{name: 'Uploads', items: [{label: upload.title, value: `uploaded::${upload.id}`}], isUploads: true}`
   - Insert at end of toolbarComboState.groups array

2. In group header rendering template:
   - Check if group.isUploads flag
   - If true, render an upload button icon in the header (in addition to toggle/checkbox)
   - Style to match existing header buttons

3. Add event handler to upload button → `triggerToolbarComboUpload()`

4. Update group collapse state logic to handle 'Uploads' group (keep it expanded by default)

**Complexity Estimate:** Low - mainly template/logic changes to existing grouped UI code. All upload functions already exist.

**Risk:** Very low - upload infrastructure is proven, just needs integration point.

notes:
All upload functions already exist and are functional:
      - promptForUploadedMixin() - file picker dialog
      - triggerToolbarComboUpload() - main entry point
      - getUploadedMixins() - retrieve from localStorage
      - upsertUploadedMixin() - add/update
      - localStorage key: 'uploadedMixins'
Current state: uploads work via 'Manage Uploaded Mixins' button, but aren't visible in the new grouped dropdown UI
New grouped dropdown architecture already handles dynamic content - just need to inject Uploads group after YAML parsing
Group header template (toolbar-combo-group-header div) already has room for action buttons - just need to add conditional upload icon
CSS for group styling already exists and is comprehensive - upload button can reuse existing .tool-btn styles
Select-all checkbox UX: for Uploads group, select-all would toggle all current uploads at once - this might be desired behavior
Future enhancement: could make uploads persist to YAML if storage layer is upgraded
